messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up — launching a 2-week plugfest to validate our gateway adapter + tooling integrations for private/on‑prem customers. Goal: a reproducible reference flow for SI partners (install, run workload, telemetry) and a short joint announcement draft once we have a working demo.

alex_pm: +1 — can we scope: 1) LlamaIndex + adapter, 2) Orch tool (orchestrator) sync, 3) HW partner (NVIDIA/edge vendor) smoke test?

sana_engineer: I can own the LlamaIndex adapter checklist. Proposed preflight: small model (7B fp16), KV cache telemetry, sample prompt set. Will throw up a sandbox repo.

tom_partnerships: I'll coordinate with the SI leads (Cognia / Skyline). Need to confirm which SI can join week of May 12. Also want marketplace listing readiness: listing asset + short security checklist.

jordan: timeline idea: week 0 (this week) = infra & onboarding docs; week 1 = run tests + fix gaps; week 2 = demo + partner review + announcement draft. Any blockers?

kyle_sre: Two SRE notes: 1) for on‑prem runs we need a minimal systemd service example and kube manifest for air‑gapped installs; 2) telemetry needs to be opt‑in by default. Sample systemd snippet:```[Unit]
Description=redwood-adapter
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-adapter --config /etc/redwood/adapter.yaml
Restart=on-failure
```

alex_pm: Great. For marketplace metadata, I'll prefill fields: short description, security contact, partner logos, and a link to the sandbox repo. Tom, can you gather partner logo assets by EOD Thu?

tom_partnerships: On it. I'll ping the SI PMs and request logos and a 2‑line blurb about their role. Also requesting an internal legal checklist for co-marketing.

sana_engineer: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/plugfest-gateway-adapter (WIP). Readme will include runbook and test harness (pytest-based). Adding an example prompt set under testdata/prompts.json.

jordan: Nice — can we add an explicit compatibility matrix in the repo: model size vs hardware profile vs expected latency? That's the thing sales and engineering always ask for.

sana_engineer: Yup. I'll add a CSV and a lightweight script to generate percentile latency numbers.```python
# scripts/summarize.py
import csv, json
# reads results/*.json and outputs matrix.csv
```

kyle_sre: Also recommend we include automated smoke deploy using deploy-bot so SI folks can trigger a demo. Something like: `/deploy-bot start plugfest-sandbox --env=onprem-demo`

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: plugfest-sandbox (env=onprem-demo). ETA for ephemeral instance: ~20m. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/plugfest-sandbox/1778881234

alex_pm: For the joint announcement: propose a short blog + partner quote + 2 minute demo video. We should draft partner talking points and a runbook for the demo so SI can rehearse.

tom_partnerships: Agree. I'll circulate a partner one‑pager template. Also want a cadence: weekly 30min sync M/W to unblock integrations. Who's in for recurring?

jordan: I'll take Mondays 9am PT. Sana you good for Wednesdays?

sana_engineer: Weds 11am PT works. I'll post the calendar invite after I finish the repo README.

akex_pm: (typo) — Alex here, I'll join Mondays too.

alex_pm: small ask: can someone validate the telemetry PII filter for prompt logs before we open the sandbox? I can coordinate a short review with security.

kyle_sre: I'll run the filter test. Share expected fields and we'll run a redaction smoke test in staging.

jordan: Thanks all — action items: Sana: repo + matrix + tests; Tom: partner assets + one‑pager; Alex: marketplace metadata + coordinate security review; Kyle: SRE smoke deploy + telemetry tests. Weekly sync invite incoming. :rocket:
